Former Vancouver Police Officer Charged with Major Fraud and Theft

Kalwinder Dosanjh, a former police officer of Punjabi origin in Vancouver, has been charged with fraud, theft, and breach of trust. The charges relate to the alleged theft of over $3 million. Dosanjh is described as a veteran officer. The specific details of the alleged breach of trust are not elaborated in the coverage.
